mechanism: AIV instruction-cache cold start: the first launch of a kernel binary in a process fetches its text, later launches of the same binary do not
harness: microbench/ascend_910b/compute/vector_pipe vector_opcode_bench, opcode 21 single_tbuf_init, 1024 elements, block_dim 48, iterations 1
measurement: msprof task duration and aiv_icache_miss_rate per launch; cold = the process's first launch, warm = the following launches of the identical cell
falsified_control: interleaving two opcodes of the same binary does not evict the cache (aiv_icache_miss_rate stays 0.000000 and the launch is not slower), so both bodies stay resident; a genuine eviction control needs two separate kernel binaries
cross_check: serving q-norm exceeds the identical isolated launch by 9.72 us at 121 tokens and 10.42 us at 2442 tokens, with per-pipe times equal to within 2 percent
